text: Extend the additive-plus-16-dimensional user-video interaction model with an auxiliary impression-level is_like binary-cross-entropy head weighted at 0.1, using the shared user-video interaction representation for the auxiliary prediction while keeping long_view as the sole scored output, the current split, optimizer, and within-user evaluation unchanged. Test whether like supervision improves long_view ordering without altering the fixed primary objective.
rationale: The referenced model reaches primary 0.588542, GAUC 0.649869, and nDCG@5 0.527215, while global AUC is 0.743545 and average precision is 0.551973, suggesting useful row-level signal but incomplete within-user ordering. Its top-five diagnostics are HitRate 0.674264, MAP 0.474292, MRR 0.533214, Precision 0.371826, and Recall 0.593116. Classification remains imbalanced diagnostically: positive rate 0.313284, recall 0.772897 versus specificity 0.581240, F1 0.574471, and Matthews correlation 0.329098. A like head can provide a less sparse engagement signal and regularize the shared interaction representation; monitor score mean -0.845108, standard deviation 1.107645, and finite min/max [-5.986806, 2.682204] to detect instability, and accept only a primary improvement.
